name: Alice
source:
A tale of how curiosity can be destructive sometimes and closed doors – seductive . The player has to witness the dark fall or the mysterious rescue of a young girl named Alice. Or maybe it's possible to find a third way, who knows, but the choice is quite obvious.

[From [url=https://lenkenvenom.itch.io/alice]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个故事讲述了好奇心有时具有破坏性，而关闭的大门却充满诱惑。玩家必须目睹黑暗的降临或一位名叫爱丽丝的年轻女孩的神秘营救。或者也许可以找到第三条路，谁知道呢，但选择是相当明显的。

[来自[url=https://lenkenvenom.itch.io/alice]itch.io[/url]]
